subject: Prepladder Tests
title: FMGE Test Series · FMGE Test Series Year 2023 · Fmge Grand Test 1

questions.stem: A 1 year and 1 month old child presented with developmental delay with her peripheral smear showing macrocytic anaemia. There is no B12 or folic acid deficiency. The compound given in the picture is excreted in the urine. Her peripheral smear is also given. What is the diagnosis?
